payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the Transformer model outperformed the ConvS2S model across all languages tested, achieving significantly higher BLEU scores.

claims.text: The Transformer model outperformed the ConvS2S model for all languages, achieving sometimes 10 BLEU points or more over ConvS2S.
The ConvS2S model had the worst performance for isiZulu, with a maximum BLEU score of 3.33, while the Transformer model performed better overall.
The results of the ablation study showed that the optimal number of BPE tokens improved performance for the Transformer model.
